description:
## What changed

GIF conversion now checks its colour precision and palette work separately. Frame encoding has its own deadline coverage too. Logger also contains failures from message builders whose own error text is broken.

Comment tools resolves every native anchor and register before changing an APK. Other patch checks now catch Java binary class names, inherited reflection contracts, false Lazy AB dispatch matches, incompatible CAPTCHA methods, and incomplete patch reports earlier.

Settings journal recovery has direct coverage for failed writes and unreadable records. Cleanup failures now keep the recovered result. Video fitting requests layout after changing gravity, while its feed and story ownership tests cover results that cannot be copied.

Release and device scripts now honor explicit Java directories, handle a clean phone during replacement, derive target metadata from the catalog, protect signing passwords from child process command lines, and verify a published bundle against its source tag.

## Validation

The release passed 1,054 runtime tests and 139 patch tests. Both Android API checks passed. The bundle carries 71 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty.

All 71 patches applied with zero failures to TikTok 46.2.3, 46.7.3, and 46.8.3 fixtures. Hushfeed officially targets the global TikTok 46.2.3 package. Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer is required.
